issues.description: Field de.tum.cit.ase.Farm.animals: The problem statement (UML and instructions) defines Farm.animals as a private attribute (UML shows "- animals: List<Animal>") and explicitly asks students to provide a getter and a setter. The solution implementation declares the field as public (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 9: "public List<Animal> animals;"). This discrepancy between the expected encapsulation (private field + accessors) and the solution's public field can confuse students about the intended visibility and encapsulation practices.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Farm.animals field in the solution to private (private List<Animal> animals;), retain the public getAnimals()/setAnimals() methods, and ensure any external code uses those accessors rather than direct field access. This aligns the solution with the UML and the problem instructions and preserves encapsulation for students to follow.
